definitions.gloss: supplier; vendor; source of goods; procurement source
definitions.explanation: A company, person, or place from which goods are purchased for resale or use in business. A fundamental term in commerce and business.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{仕入先|しいれさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: To look for a new supplier.

examples.japanese: {仕入先|しいれさき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難航|なんこう}している→難航する：19360_nankousuru⟧。
examples.english: Price negotiations with the supplier are proving difficult.

examples.japanese: {仕入先|しいれさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{複数|ふくすう}→複数：14236_fukusuu⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧おくことで、⟦{供給|きょうきゅう}→供給：02599_kyoukyuu⟧⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分散|ぶんさん}→分散：18624_bunsan⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: By securing multiple suppliers, you can spread the supply risk.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{仕入|しい}れ→仕入れ：07431_shiire⟧ (purchasing, stocking) + ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (destination, party). The suffix ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ is productive in business Japanese, creating words for counterparties: ⟦{取引先|とりひきさき}→取引先：11083_torihikisaki⟧ (business partner), {納入先|のうにゅうさき} (delivery destination), {販売先|はんばいさき} (customer/sales destination).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仕入先|しいれさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to look for a supplier
- {仕入先|しいれさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧: to change suppliers
- {仕入先|しいれさき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: relationship with suppliers
- {仕入先|しいれさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開拓|かいたく}→開拓：09954_kaitaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to develop new suppliers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- サプライヤー: supplier (loanword; common in manufacturing and international business)
- ⟦{取引先|とりひきさき}→取引先：11083_torihikisaki⟧: business partner (broader; includes both suppliers and customers)
- {卸売業者|おろしうりぎょうしゃ}: wholesaler (a specific type of supplier)
